topic.title: How to Change the Font of MathML Equations

indexterm.product: author developer editor authorEclipse developerEclipse editorEclipse

body.note: An equation can be rendered using multiple classes of fonts (e.g. the serif, sans serif, monospace, fraktur, and doublestruck classes. Depending on each of the equation symbols, a class is selected for it. The font specified in the CSS rule (as in the preceding example), applies only to the serif class. However, if a symbol codepoint is not covered by the currently selected class fonts, it falls back to the font specified in the CSS.
Some of the fonts may not be supported. In that case, a default serif font is used.
